title: Carnival Awards and Prize Handover Corner
description: One static carnival awards and prize-handover corner under the original prize-collection scene program. A complete three-place integrated rank podium fronts a clear ceremony apron. A whole concave-L canopy counter remains to the rear-left as a handover position, and a whole empty two-level corner rack occupies a separate rear-right display position. The rack is explicitly the unchanged published logistics shelf reused for display, not a new prize-rack model, recolor, stripped cabinet or filled prize inventory. One closed base and two separate thin approach/apron solids are scene-only. Three whole unit-scale published models preserve all geometry and materials. One scene, zero new independent models. This is a front-facing awards platform and side-handover court, not the old arch/ring-toss stall, ticket entrance or a toy-shop cabinet wall with swapped goods. No winners, prizes, stock, transactions, ranking logic, load, event crowd flow, accessibility or real safety certification is claimed.
